headline: Niko was deemed dangerous and ordered humanely euthanized, and Starla and Sapphire were deemed dangerous and placed under conditions.
summary: Roberto Morat's dog Luna was deemed a nuisance, and conditions were set for Prince, Diva and Luna. Niko was deemed dangerous and ordered humanely euthanized. Starla and Sapphire, owned by David Benoit, were deemed dangerous and given conditions.
decisions: Approved the December 18, 2025 minutes, 4-0 with one absent.
Deemed the dog Luna a nuisance, 4-0 with one absent.
Approved conditions for Prince, Diva and Luna, 4-0 with one absent: licensing, vaccination and registration for all three dogs, and leashing and muzzling for Luna.
Deemed the dog Niko dangerous, 4-0 with one absent.
Ordered the dog Niko humanely euthanized, 4-0 with one absent.
Deemed the dogs Starla and Sapphire dangerous, 4-0 with one absent.
Approved six conditions for Starla and Sapphire, including restraint, confinement, muzzling, sterilization, microchipping, transfer limits and fence maintenance, 4-0 with one absent.

plain_text:
Animal Control Hearing  
                                                              Minutes 
Call to Order 
10:00 AM Meeting called to order on Thursday, July 16, 2026 at City Hall -- Room 205, 36 
Court Street, Springfield, MA. 
 
Attendee Name Title Status Arrived 
Melvin A. Edwards Ward 3 Councilor Present  
Keith Fleming Police  Present  
Camile Nelson Campbell Assistant City Clerk Present  
Megan Landry Board Member Present  
Veronica Johns Board Member Absent  
Approval of Minutes 
1. December 18, 2025 Minutes 
Read. 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to accept the minutes the motion was 
seconded by Board Member Landry. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns     Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell yes 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
Minutes approved. 
Dog Hearing 
2. A Dangerous Dog Hearing For Three dogs named Prince, Diva and Luna Owned by 
Roberto Morat at 150 Elmore Ave. 
 
Read.
Renee Robichaud and Elfred Mateo, Animal Control Officers for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) 
and Adoption Center read their reports.   
 
Complainant  
Silk Morrison stated he was bitten before and he just wants something to be done. 
 
Respondent 
Roberto Morat did not appear. 
Rebuttal 
None 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to deem the dog named Luna as nuisance 
the motion was seconded by Board Member Landry. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
After review of the hearing testimonies and the Thomas J. O’Connor Animal Control and 
Adoption Center reports, the Committee has imposed the following conditions on Prince, 
Diva and Luna: 
1. That all three (3) dogs in your household be licensed, vaccinated and registered, in 
accordance with c. 110 § 2 of the Code. 
2. That Luna, be leashed and muzzled in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(9) of the Code. 
Roll call votes on the conditions 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell yes 
 
Conditions passed by roll call votes
3. A Dangerous Dog Hearing for a Dog named Niko Owned by Jose Garcia at 194 Pine 
St  
  
Read. 
Renee Robichaud and Elfred Mateo, Animal Control Officers for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) 
and Adoption Center read their reports.   
 
Complainant  
Cherrella Hicks stated she was walking her dog, Levi, when she noticed a big dog to her left coming 
towards her and her dog, Levi. She called out to the man and asked him to get his dog, and he just stood 
there and did nothing. She tried to grab and shield her dog, but the bigger dog snatched up her dog and 
began to fling her dog, Levi around like a stuffed toy. Again, she cried out for help at the man, and he 
just stood there and said he only works there and could not control the dog. The owner of the dog never 
came to her and asks how ‘s her dog, Levi. The worker called for a woman to take the dog, and she took 
the dog and fled the scene. She took her dog, Levi to the animal hospital in West Springfield, due to 
Levi’s bite wounds, he had to be euthanized. 
 
Respondent 
Vanessa Hernandez spoke in Spanish and Elfred Mateo translated what she said. 
Elfred translations stated that Jose Garcia is not the owner and he is no longer living in the 
country and that she owns the dogs over the years. She said she turned in the other dog to 
Thomas J. O’Connor Animal Shelter and she has Niko.  
Rebuttal 
None 
 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to deem the dog named Niko as dangerous 
the motion was seconded by Board Member Landry. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes.
After review of the hearing testimonies and the Thomas J. O’Connor Animal Control and 
Adoption Center reports, the Committee has imposed the following condition on Niko: 
1. That the dog be humanely euthanized, in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(8) of the Code 
Roll call votes on the conditions 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell yes 
 
Condition passed by roll call votes  
 
Non-Compliance  
4. A Non-Compliance Nuisance Dog Hearing for two (2) dogs named Starla and 
Sapphire Owned by David Benoit at 279 Garnet St 
 
Read. 
Renee Robichaud And Elfred Matos, Animal Control Officers for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) 
and Adoption Center read their reports.   
 
Complainant 
Cherryln  
Respondent 
David Benoit 
Rebuttal 
None 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to deem the dogs named Starla and 
Sapphire as Dangerous dogs the motion was seconded by Board Member Fleming. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
After review of the hearing testimonies and the Thomas J. O’Connor Animal Control and 
Adoption Center reports, the Committee has imposed the following conditions on Starla 
and Sapphire: 
1. That the dogs be humanely restrained, in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(1) of the Code; 
 
2. That the dogs be confined to the premises of the owner; provided, however, that 
"confined" shall mean securely confined indoors or confined outdoors in a securely 
enclosed and locked pen or dog run area upon the premises of the owner; provided 
however, that such confinement shall comply with § 110-8 of the Code, in accordance 
with c. 110 § 10(B)(2) of the Code; 
3. That, whenever removed from the premises of the owner, the dogs shall be securely and 
humanely muzzled and restrained with a leash having a minimum tensile strength of 300 
pounds and not exceeding three feet in length, in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(3) of the 
Code; 
4. That the dogs shall be surgically sterilized and microchipped with the microchip 
registered to the City, with all costs associated with these services to be borne by the 
owner, in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(4) of the Code; 
5. That ownership of the dogs may not be transferred unless the transfer of ownership is to 
an adult residing within the same residence and the dog(s) shall remain housed solely at 
that residence, in accordance with c. 110 § 10(B)(6) of the Code; 
6. That the owner maintains a well-maintained fence to keep the dogs secured on the 
property; TJO O’Connor and Adoption Center Officers will visit the property on Friday, 
July 17, 2026 to inspect the current fence and identify necessary improvements. TJO 
O’Connor officers will revisit the property seven days after you have received this letter 
to confirm that the identified improvements have been made, in accordance with c. 110 § 
10(B)(9) of the Code. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
Conditions passed by roll call votes
